title: Group Preference Alignment: Customized LLM Response Generation from In-Situ Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model output preferences using an LLM-as-a-judge with persona-role playing to compare win-tie-lose rates for users from different geographic and cultural backgrounds (U.S. vs. China, U.S. vs. India) on creative writing tasks.

Evaluating model output preferences using an LLM-as-a-judge with persona-role playing to compare win-tie-lose rates for users with different levels of domain knowledge (Experts vs. Novices) on programming and education tasks.
